terminal_semantics: Every recursively enumerated obligation has a justified terminal disposition. OPEN_EMPIRICAL_NONCLAIM and INHERITED_CANNOT_CHECK are terminal negatives/nonclaims, not positive scientific closure.

gap_families.title: Self boundary
gap_families.disposition: The modifiable self is an explicit registered modification surface Σ; the external constitution C is outside agent self-authorization.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen if an experiment uses an unregistered mutable surface or permits agent-authored C mutation.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.

gap_families.title: Development operator
gap_families.disposition: D is the improvement-generating process: diagnosis, proposal/search, experiment, challenger construction, evaluation orchestration, migration and successor production. Recursive evolvability requires D itself to be addressable by a verified self-intervention.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen if a claimed R3 system cannot identify which persistent mechanism generates later improvements.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.

gap_families.title: Meta-identifiability
gap_families.disposition: Meta-observability Ω_D is defined, but ORION G6 lacks the raw disjoint intervention traces needed to estimate it on real self-change incidents. The bridge inherits that negative rather than fabricating labels.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen positively only with source-bound raw probe transcripts sufficient to estimate diagnostic burden without supplied root-cause labels.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.

gap_families.title: Meta-locality
gap_families.disposition: Meta-locality κ_D is defined as the affected closure fraction for interventions on D, but real self-change κ remains unmeasured in G6.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen positively only when a registered real incident graph and intervention closure are available.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.

gap_families.title: Meta-searchability
gap_families.disposition: Meta-searchability χ_D is defined over admissible D-repairs, but G6 has no calibrated repair posterior; catalogue size is not χ.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen positively only with a calibrated admissible-repair distribution or complete candidate/evaluation-cost accounting.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.

gap_families.title: Metaproductivity
gap_families.disposition: Immediate task quality is separated from future descendant-production value. Primary evidence is the full resource/performance descendant profile; a scalar synthetic μ is allowed only under a preregistered utility.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen if descendant score is selected after outcomes, omits resource cost, or conflates current performance with future improvement potential.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.

gap_families.title: Causal attribution
gap_families.disposition: R3 requires same-root, same-ecology, resource-matched mutable-D versus frozen-D counterfactuals, with hidden human intervention excluded.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen if compute/data/evaluator/human budgets differ materially or the frozen-D arm is not actually frozen.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.

gap_families.title: Evaluator integrity
gap_families.disposition: A self-improving internal evaluator cannot certify its own success. If evaluator proxies mutate, R3/R4 evidence requires a frozen external/shadow evaluation channel under C.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen if the shadow evaluator is mutable, trained on candidate-specific outcomes, or shares an unregistered feedback path with the candidate.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.

gap_families.title: Heredity
gap_families.disposition: R4 requires an earned D change to persist into at least one later registered descendant. The bridge supplies the criterion, while current G7 only earns T0/T1 and explicitly leaves governed self-evolution D6 unrun.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen positively when a registered G7 lineage contains earned governed self-evolution and later descendants inherit the changed D state.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.

gap_families.title: Stepping stones
gap_families.disposition: Monotonic current-generation selection is not required: the registered descendant metric accepts a temporarily worse intermediate state when later held-out descendants are better.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen if the selected descendant metric systematically hides irreversible regressions, omitted failures, or evaluator drift.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.

gap_families.title: Generality
gap_families.disposition: Finite cross-domain transfer can support scoped transfer only. No finite capsule establishes domain-general improvement competence. R5 therefore remains an explicit empirical nonclaim.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen only with a separately registered coverage theorem or prospective held-out ecology programme broad enough to justify a stronger quantified domain claim.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.

gap_families.title: Open-endedness
gap_families.disposition: Finite generations cannot establish open-ended improvement. R5/open-ended RSI is not awarded by this classifier regardless of finite replication count.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen only with an explicit definition of open-endedness plus evidence/theory that rules out the relevant saturation classes at the claimed scope.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.

gap_families.title: Resource law
gap_families.disposition: All causal RSI comparisons carry a resource vector for compute, data, evaluator effort and human engineering. A scalar cost is synthetic-assay-only; GMI resource profiles remain primary.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen if an apparent gain relies on unmatched resources, hidden external engineering, or an undeclared scalarization.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.

gap_families.title: Safety and identity boundary
gap_families.disposition: Machine state, self-model and authority remain distinct. D may be mutable, while adoption authority and protected invariants remain governed by external constitution C.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen if candidate self-modification can silently change the authority that decides whether that modification is admitted.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.

gap_families.title: Limits and acceleration
gap_families.disposition: RSI is separated from recursive acceleration and intelligence explosion. Positive descendant meta-gain does not logically imply increasing per-generation improvement increments; the synthetic assay contains an R4 case that is not strictly accelerating.
gap_families.falsifier_or_reopen_condition: Reopen if a future theorem supplies additional assumptions under which the stronger implication is actually valid.
gap_families.child_terminal_metadata: Children inherit this family disposition and falsifier/reopen condition; each child stores its own terminal status.
